hero.title: Frequently Asked
hero.description: Find answers to common questions about our courses and platform

questions.question: How do live classes work?
questions.answer: All our classes are conducted via Google Meet. Once you enroll in a course, you'll receive a meeting link and schedule. Classes are interactive with live Q&A sessions.

questions.question: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.answer: We accept payments through Stripe (credit/debit cards) and also offer direct payment options. Contact us for more details on payment plans.

questions.question: Can I access course materials after the class?
questions.answer: Yes! All registered students get lifetime access to course materials, recordings, and resources through their dashboard.

questions.question: What if I miss a live class?
questions.answer: Don't worry! All live sessions are recorded and made available within 24 hours. You can watch them at your convenience.

questions.question: Do I need prior coding experience?
questions.answer: It depends on the course. We offer courses for all levels - from complete beginners to advanced developers. Check the course requirements before enrolling.

questions.question: Is there a refund policy?
questions.answer: Yes, we offer a 7-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied with the course within the first week, contact us for a full refund.

questions.question: How do I get support if I'm stuck?
questions.answer: You can ask questions during live classes, post in our community forum, or schedule office hours with the instructor.

questions.question: Will I receive a certificate?
questions.answer: Yes! Upon successful completion of a course, you'll receive a certificate of completion that you can add to your portfolio or LinkedIn.

contactUs: Contact us and we'll be happy to help!
